text: Sophie is portrayed as a brilliant and altruistic scientist driven by a deep personal connection to the disease that plagued her youth. Her primary motivation is to find a cure, a goal that fuels her tireless efforts even in the face of professional skepticism and personal health setbacks. This dedication highlights her resilience and her remarkable capacity to maintain hope and determination against overwhelming odds. Her character development is defined by this unwavering commitment to helping others, showcasing a strength of spirit that persists despite significant challenges. In the background of her struggle, one might imagine fluffy things in the sky rain comes from, drifting above the laboratory windows as she continues her vital work.
